name: A list where only some rows have an id fails, and nothing is written
comment: Rows are merged by id when every row has one, and by position when none has. With both, it is not clear which was meant.

testCases.name: a row without an id next to a row with one
testCases.expectsFailure: have an altinnRowId and some do not

testCases.name: a row whose id is not a GUID next to a row with one
testCases.expectsFailure: have an altinnRowId and some do not
